newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips lose footing, trip NYSE curbs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips lose footing, trip NYSE curbs.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks, which had been steady but lower for most of the afternoon, slipped further, prompting the New York Stock Exchange to put curbs on index-arbitrage trading an hour ahead of the session's close.

The Dow Jones industrial average was off 50 points or 0.69 percent to 7333, setting the curbs at 1505 EDT/1905 GMT according to the Big Board. The Standard & Poor's 500 Index was down nearly five to 845, also session lows.
Breadth on the NYSE was almost exactly even with advancers just beating out decliners by one issue, 1,208 to 1,207.
